markerLegend.†: DERIVED FROM AN UNGATED POPULATION. Entry to these meets is open — anybody may enter, nothing had to be cleared to be in this field. The number describes what the people who showed up totalled. IT IS NOT A QUALIFYING STANDARD and no lifter in it had to meet one. See qualifying-totals.md §4.2 (regional) and §4.7 (local).
markerLegend.‡: MIXED METHOD: this cell is NOT the same statistic as the unmarked ones. It is the total reached by the strongest 25% of the tier BELOW, not a percentile of this tier's own field, because this tier's field is filled by national quota rather than by standard. See qualifying-totals.md §3.6.
